findings: Crane receiver heard NO energy on any channel: crane nRF receive path is dead, or CE is not reaching the module (check the CE jumper on J3.3 / J7.10).
GS did not hear the crane's carrier (RPD 320/8586): crane transmitter or CE path at fault, or the radios are too far apart.
Crane did not hear the GS carrier (RPD 0/3551): crane receiver / CE at fault, or GS transmitter dead.
